import html # Predefined HTML structure for a blog post. BLOG_FORMAT = """ {title}

{title}

{body}
""" def create_blog_post(heading: str, text: str) -> str: """ Prepare a user-submitted blog post for secure web display. Parameters ---------- heading : str The main heading or subject of the blog post. text : str The complete textual content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A sanitized and HTML‑formatted string ready for rendering on the webpage. Raises ------ ValueError If either heading or text is empty. """ if not heading: raise ValueError("Heading cannot be empty.") if not text: raise ValueError("Text content cannot be empty.") # Escape all HTML special characters to prevent injection. safe_heading = html.escape(heading, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(text, quote=True) # Replace newlines with
tags for proper formatting in the browser. safe_body = safe_body.replace('\n', '
') return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_heading, body=safe_body)
